# About Soloinsight Inc
Soloinsight Inc, established 2013, headquartered in Charleston, SC is a global leader in Security Workflow Automation and Access Control Solutions. Leveraging our CloudGate Platform, Soloinsight provides integrated solutions to effectively manage both Physical and Digital Identities across diverse industries.
![About Soloinsight Inc](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8c41d9_18df7f1f996d44c996a33fdd0a6106fd~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_553,h_341,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/About%20Us.jpg)
![people](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/8c41d9_59231308b5cf44979772cc9ce6cf4ca3~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_356,h_341,fp_0.50_0.44,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/Why%20Soloinsight.jpg)
## What we do
Soloinsight offers a range of services through its CloudGate Platform, including CloudGate Physical Identity & Access Management, Enterprise Visitor Management, Space Reservation Solution, Mobile Access Solutions, Smart Parking, Smart Intercom Systems and Emergency Mustering Services. These offerings ensure secure experience for managing Employees, Service Providers, Contractors, Vendors, and Visitors across multiple locations and industries. Today CloudGate seamlessly integrates with major Physical Access Control Systems (PACS) giving organizations the option to enhance their Workplace Experience without needing to completely replace existing systems.

## About CloudGate
Soloinsight offers a range of services through its CloudGate Platform, including CloudGate Physical Identity & Access Management, Enterprise Visitor Management, Space Reservation Solution, Mobile Access Solutions, Smart Parking, Smart Intercom Systems, and Emergency Mustering Services.
#### Automation unleashed:  
Freeing up your time
No more getting bogged down by tedious onboarding paperwork or the manual grind of access provisioning. CloudGate automates these routine tasks, freeing you and your team to focus on bigger priorities. From badging and visitor registration to access updates and security checks, CloudGate handles the mundane, letting you dedicate your energy to driving meaningful progress.
#### Granular control:  
Access tailored to every need
Security isn't one-size-fits-all. CloudGate understands this, providing you with the granularity to define precise roles, permissions, and access schedules for every individual. Sensitive areas remain tightly secured, while authorized personnel enjoy seamless access, creating a dynamic security environment that adapts to your unique needs.
#### A warm welcome:  
Visitor management reinvented
Bid farewell to clipboards and logbooks! CloudGate transforms visitor management into a professional and efficient experience. Pre-registration options, touchless sign-in kiosks, and real-time visitor logs ensure a smooth and secure entry process, leaving your guests with a positive impression that reflects your commitment to hospitality and security.
#### Mobile convenience:  
Access at your fingertips
Why fumble with clunky keycards when you can tap and go? CloudGate empowers your employees and authorized personnel with mobile credentials, allowing them to access your facilities securely and conveniently using their smartphones. This modern approach not only eliminates the risk of lost or stolen keys but also simplifies access management for you.
#### Seamless integration:  
Building on your foundation
No need to start from scratch. CloudGate seamlessly integrates with your existing PACS and security systems, creating a unified and optimized security ecosystem. This ensures smooth operation, minimizes disruption, and allows you to leverage the investments you've already made in your physical security infrastructure.
#### Transparency and accountability: Governance made easy 
Staying ahead of regulations and upholding company policies is crucial. CloudGate empowers you with comprehensive audit trails and detailed reporting capabilities, providing complete visibility into access activity and ensuring accountability at every level. This transparency not only promotes compliance but also strengthens your overall security posture.
#### Unified Access Control
With our platform, you can implement enterprise-wide controls and workflows for efficiently managing employees, service providers, contractors, vendors, and visitors, using policy-based workflows and technology integrated into IAM and HR systems. This significantly reduces organizational risk, aids regulated industries in audits and compliance, and minimizes the costs associated with managing identities across multiple systems.
